0022600088.text: Both the Toronto Raptors and Chicago Bulls open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with Toronto hosting, and the Bulls are missing Isaac Okoro (undisclosed), Nic Claxton (hamstring), Tobe Awaka (knee), and Zach Collins (toe, surgery), all listed as day-to-day. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Raptors a 75% chance of winning, though Brandon Ingram is out after Achilles surgery and Chucky Hepburn and Nate Bittle are day-to-day with hamstring and foot issues. Toronto won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 139-109 win in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
